metadata.title: Light rays of Lorentzian graphs and the Born-Infeld model
metadata.abstract: Following a program outlined by Bartnik, and also employing nonlinear potential techniques we developed in the last years, we study lightlike singularities of variational solutions to the prescribed Lorentzian mean curvature equation with possibly unbounded (rough) curvature. This corresponds to allowing for unbounded charges in the Born-Infeld model.

analysis.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
analysis.workSummary: 研究具有可能无界规定 Lorentz 平均曲率的变分解的类光奇点，对应 Born–Infeld 模型中的无界电荷。
analysis.breakthrough: 将类光奇性分析推进到粗糙、无界曲率或电荷的数据范围。
analysis.limitations: 摘要未列出精确可积性门槛和奇集结构，须以正文定理为准。
analysis.aiEvidence: 作者披露 LLM 用于排印语法纠错、表述检查及证明复查；数学思想和证明策略由作者提出。
